source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.13
text: After cleaning/treatment, seed is soaked and pre-germinated before sowing in three timed steps: (1) Soak the seed in clean, ideally flowing/changed water for about 24 hours. (2) Drain and transfer the soaked seed into a breathable sack and let it incubate (sprout) for about 48 hours, turning/mixing it once partway through so heat and moisture are even and germination is uniform. (3) Before sowing, check that seeds have reached the correct germination point — visible root and shoot tips of about 1–2 mm — indicating the seed is ready to be sown onto the nursery bed.
